title: nan
authors: Chiang K.W.; Tsai G.J.; Chang H.W.; Joly C.; EI-Sheimy N.
key_contribution: Proposes a semi-tightly coupled INS/GNSS/grid-based SLAM integration for robust navigation and mapping in GNSS-denied environments, achieving 1-2 m accuracy experimentally.
problem_solved: Addressing state estimation drift in GNSS-denied navigation.
methodology_summary: Fuses sensor data using LiDAR_SLAM to ensure precise positioning.
